question: Let $f(x)$ be a polynomial with integer coefficients. Assume that 3 divides the value $f(n)$ for each integer $n$. Prove that when $f(x)$ is divided by $x^3-x$, the remainder is of the form $3r(x)$, where $r(x)$ is a polynomial with integer coefficients.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
